entries.researchQuestion: Can a reproducible multi-language corpus be built primarily from versioned PDF documentation while retaining HTML where PDFs are unavailable?
entries.variable: Corpus source coverage and source format
entries.decision: Use the expanded PDF-first corpus as the common experimental corpus.
limitations: Some living documentation remains HTML
Corpus balance by language is not uniform
entries.nextStep: Preserve corpus hashes in every experiment.

entries.researchQuestion: Can a balanced, source-grounded benchmark and a genuinely untouched test split support the next retrieval experiments?
entries.variable: Case coverage, answerability balance, approval provenance, and split membership
controls: Previously scored cases excluded from the fresh test
entries.decision: Use the 30-case balanced v2 benchmark for engineering validation. Keep the six newly curated cases as a locked fresh test; all operational human approvals remain explicitly pending independent user confirmation.
limitations: Only six fresh test cases
All approval records are provisional
Coverage remains uneven across the full corpus language set
entries.nextStep: Confirm every checklist item, freeze the retrieval selection rule, then execute the six-case test exactly once.

entries.researchQuestion: How does target chunk size affect retrieval quality, index size, latency, and embedding cost?
entries.decision: Retain 300 target words as the exploratory baseline. The 2x3 interaction validation confirms higher Gemini precision at 300 words and no model-ranking reversal.
limitations: Many source sections remain shorter than the configured minimum
Oversized source blocks require a separate boundary experiment
entries.nextStep: Compare boundary and overlap strategies independently.

entries.researchQuestion: Which cosine threshold suppresses unrelated retrieval without reducing answerable recall?
entries.decision: The preliminary 0.65 threshold was superseded after expanding negative cases.
limitations: Only one negative case
No validation/test split

entries.researchQuestion: Does a threshold selected on balanced validation generalize to an untouched test split?
entries.decision: Select 0.75 on validation; retain the 1/6 test version false positive without retuning.
limitations: Source-verified rather than human-approved cases
Small split size
Test is consumed for this configuration
entries.nextStep: Evaluate explicit version compatibility on validation and create a future test revision before final comparison.

entries.researchQuestion: Do lexical BM25 or unweighted hybrid RRF improve over dense cosine on the current benchmark?
entries.decision: Keep dense cosine; BM25 and simple RRF fail the declared guardrails.
limitations: Benchmark has limited exact-lookup queries
BM25 uses a basic analyzer
entries.nextStep: Prioritize metadata filtering and reranking; retain technical BM25 as an optional later variant.

entries.researchQuestion: Can query-corpus technology and version compatibility reduce false positives without harming answerable retrieval?
entries.decision: On the expanded 24-case validation split, pure dense thresholds cannot satisfy all guardrails. Metadata-aware dense selects 0.65 and reaches Recall@4, MRR, and nDCG@4 of 1.0 with zero no-answer false positives.
limitations: Rule-based query recognition may miss implicit technologies or aliases
Metadata coverage and correctness become retrieval dependencies
Approvals are provisional
The six-case fresh test remains intentionally untouched
entries.nextStep: Freeze metadata-aware Gemini retrieval at threshold 0.65 for the next engineering stage; confirm the benchmark before the one-time test.

entries.researchQuestion: Which embedding model and dimensionality provide the best quality-cost trade-off?
entries.variable: Embedding provider/model at a fixed 1024-dimensional output
entries.decision: On validation, retain Gemini Embedding 2 as the baseline and Voyage Code 3 as the strongest alternative. Gemini remains ahead at 300, 450, and 850 target words; no model-ranking reversal is observed.
limitations: Provider availability and prices may change
Only twelve validation cases are available
The existing test split has already been observed and cannot support final model selection
Indexing latency is not comparable because cache resumptions and provider rate limits differed
entries.nextStep: Expand and human-approve the benchmark, create a fresh untouched test split, freeze the selection rule, and evaluate it once.

entries.researchQuestion: Does reranking a fixed dense candidate pool improve ordering quality enough to justify added latency and cost?
entries.variable: No reranker, cross-encoder, or LLM reranker
limitations: Requires a larger ranking-sensitive benchmark

entries.researchQuestion: How do generator choices affect grounded answer quality, and how reliably can an LLM judge reproduce human assessments?
entries.variable: Generator model, judge model, and judge prompt in separate experiments
limitations: Judge must not validate itself
Human calibration is required
entries.nextStep: Build human-labelled calibration cases after retrieval stabilizes.

entries.researchQuestion: Does retrieve-check-rewrite improve success enough to justify extra iterations, latency, and cost?
entries.variable: Single pass versus bounded retrieve-check-rewrite loop
limitations: Must not hide a weak single-pass baseline
entries.nextStep: Run only after retrieval, generation, and judge baselines are frozen.
